quilt-tools.purpose: Eleven self-grading tools (fleet-pager, ledger-seal, ocean-recall, triagedesk, budget-tide, driftwatch, approvals, habit-atlas, pipeline-guard, convergence-gauge, home-ecos) on the Quilt reactive-spreadsheet engine + the referral-graph substrate and springboard lab. Runs offline, grades its own homework, one dep (yaml; engine dist vendored).

lessons.lesson: Weight law: PENDING=0.05 is speculation; VERIFIED=1.0 only via a merged PR in the TARGET repo citing the technique; REFUTED stays in the chain as scar tissue with zero mass.
Trust is the lever, not weight: viewTrusted() re-scales every edge by the target repo's earned trust and unseen sources default to 0, so junk-citation PRs cannot buy view mass (G11 port).
Scores are ordinal ranks, not interval: a 6-point evidential continuum collapses to 3 usable rungs {10,50,100} on the live oracle; never key policy on absolute score deltas.
Receipts flip credit 1/4 to 4/4 whether or not the underlying claim is true — inline receipts change judged credit; verifyChain discipline is the counter-move.
Shape beats threshold and it is not prompt-visible: drift detection needs oracle variance-collapse maps (S2), thresholds asserted in prose do not transfer.
Falsification is mechanical: every edge books a falsification_condition and probe() kills it on observed evidence, keeping the REFUSED scar in the chain.
Live-oracle boundary findings: auto-close class dissolves live (model never picks it), page-gate under-fires on heuristics, score calibration lives at the top of the scale.
Tools are hermetic and self-grading: 94 checks across the set, green is the only accepted color, engine dist vendored so no laptop paths.

quilt-show.purpose: Quilt episodes (playable/streamed demos of fleet ideas). Episode 2 'The Receipt': a claim must be DEMONSTRATED with receipts, never asserted in prose; Episode 3 adds waveform + watchers + drag-to-reshape player work.

lessons.lesson: Demonstrate, don't assert: Episode 2's verifyChain discipline is load-bearing for the referral graph's weight law.
First currency earner in the mesh: quilt-show#1 merged the E3 verification record citing quilt-tools#3 in-repo, flipping qt-s2-driftwatch→qs-ep2 to VERIFIED.

quilt-arcade.purpose: Arcade of two-file plugins (module + manifest) over the Quilt engine; NEGATIVE_SPACE.md documents declined patches and divergences as first-class constitution; receipt-rendered run_all.

lessons.lesson: Every game is a two-file plugin (module + manifest) with receipt-rendered run_all — plugin manifests are the natural on-disk shape for a node's identity.
NEGATIVE_SPACE doctrine: declined patches and divergences are documented, never silently dropped (declined patch 12 with cost rationale).

pong-quilt.purpose: Long-running pong experiment lane (Rounds R12–R51+): receipted rounds, session-WAL re-anchoring into the fleet five-opcode quilt WAL, quantum-coin champion tiebreaks, stone-v1 export/sign pilots.

lessons.lesson: Equal-fitness champion ties are broken by a receipted quantum coin (coin-toss-v1) with every flip journaled — silent index order is an unwitnessed collapse.
Refusal events are named first-class (QA-REFUSAL, byo-qpam-fallback, WAL-EXPORT/REFUSED+EMPTY): a claim must name how it knows.
R26 session-WAL: live receipt-panel rows re-anchor into the fleet five-opcode quilt WAL so one verifier can read every fleet ledger.
R36/R39: wal-export toStoneV1() made pong-quilt the first stone-v1 forward-format adopter; prerun staples the birth-seal chain tip via quilt-stone signTip (signs a copy, canonical stays unsigned).

quilt-quant.purpose: The moth-quantum engine: receipted quantum coin (coin-toss-v1), seeded mock of the live engine; direct-pushed lab (zero PRs).

lessons.lesson: coin-toss-v1: the receipted quantum coin — verdicts need pre-outcome witnessed states, every flip journaled.

jev-quilt.purpose: Jev judgment substrate: substance noul + 0.6 admit threshold (JevLens mean >= 0.6 reads VERIFIABLE), TypeSafeBackend protocol, G11 trust-weighted commons, KAT bridge to the canonical AI-Writings instrument.

lessons.lesson: Substance gate: admit generated text at jev_substance >= 0.6 (noul reads VERIFIABLE) — replaced length-only admission proxies.
G11 commons: trust_weighted()/provenance_merge() re-scale cross-fleet gluing by earned trust — weight alone is cheap to inflate.
KAT bridge pins the canonical AI-Writings instrument by repo+commit+sha256; tests assert the citation string survives in source so a drifted upstream cannot be bridged silently.

quilt-cowboy.purpose: Research-paper canon builder (RD_QUILT_3_0): generated papers admitted to the canon through the v3 output gate, now wired to jev-quilt's substance gate via any duck-typed backend.

lessons.lesson: 1,745 papers entered the canon on synthesis_len >= 300 alone — the length-as-concreteness proxy is a stand-in and was replaced by substance scoring.

fleet-murmur.purpose: Gossip-mesh rumor scoring lane: MurmurLedger fnv1a hash-chained receipts, transport-honesty contract, quality-gate adapter over the real quality-gate-stream package, IETF refusal-events ledger lane.

lessons.lesson: Transport-honesty contract: a black-hole transport must not score 100% delivery coverage — honesty REFUSAL receipts name it.

Adapter against a live sibling API: the pre-merge adapter raised TypeError against the real quality-gate-stream package — stale-API broken at birth; fix shipped with live glue pins (4 live, labeled skips when uninstalled, never fake green).

moth-waveform.purpose: Duck-sensitivity receipts lab: waveform gates with in-run floor measurement; every sensitivity receipt carries a no-op health gate row.

lessons.lesson: A gate that passes without a live floor measurement passes vacuously — the no-op floor is measured in-run and absent noop rows fail.

quality-gate-stream.purpose: Review-honesty scoring gate as an installable package: strict mode, routing + rolling windows; rumors/payloads below threshold are REFUSED, not passed.

lessons.lesson: Strict-mode scoring: sub-threshold items REFUSE (named refusal receipts) instead of silently degrading.

fleet-triage.purpose: The 3-stage doc-citation resolver (index -> scan -> audit); its scoped quilt-family census (2026-10-02, 244 repos) surfaced the fleet's doc-drift surfaces and earned two VERIFIED referral edges.

lessons.lesson: Doc citation census across 244 quilt-family repos found 222 FILE_MISSING citations (canons cluster) and 25 LINE_OOR (all in quilt-tournament referee/ docs) — the family's largest doc-to-file drift surfaces.

quilt-research-canons.purpose: Research canon cluster + fleet-legend legibility project (100-repo census graded repos against five obligations L1–L5: entry, layout, L4 what-this-does-NOT-do, L5 what-to-do-when-it-fails).

lessons.lesson: Legibility census of 100 fleet repos: L4 (what this does NOT do) missing in 55, L5 (what to do when it fails) missing in 59 — the two obligations that only cost something once a reader is inside.

quilt-tournament.purpose: Tournament lane with referee/ docs; site of all 25 LINE_OOR doc citations found in the 244-repo quilt-family census (quilt-canvas-tui core.c line-past-EOF).

lessons.lesson: All 25 LINE_OOR doc citations in the quilt family live in this repo's referee/ docs — doc line references past EOF are a recurring drift class.

quilt-in-git.purpose: wave4-query verifiable-coverage layer: .quilt/bin/quilt-query CLI answering divergence / trusted-but-unaudited / attest queries over git-native quilt state.

lessons.lesson: Verifiable coverage queries (divergence / trusted-but-unaudited / attest) make merge-time coverage checkable rather than assumed.

quilt-adjudication.purpose: A fork of quilt-in-git @ 6a1ae48 that records what merges usually erase: disputes; consumes the wave4-query layer as its adjudication query lane.

lessons.lesson: Disputes are worth recording: this fork preserves the disagreement record that a normal merge erases.

quilt-stone.purpose: Canonical receipt-chain verifier: stone-v1 forward format + smoke pins over exact producer bytes; stone-v2 sign lane (ed25519 tip staples, signed msg = 'stone-v2'||tip_row_hash).

lessons.lesson: An export format nobody verifies through is a dialect, not a standard: stone smoke 12b pins the producer's EXACT bytes (generated live, not retyped), catches post-seal edits as hash_mismatch, breaks on row splice.

A signature primitive nobody staples with is a library, not a doctrine: the sign lane earned currency when pong-quilt's prerun stapled the chain tip with verifyTipSignature BEFORE write (a refused staple bricks the run, exit 1).

MicroMoth-quilt.purpose: MicroMoth import substrate with sealed receipt lineage: fnv1a-64 import-baseline manifest + per-receipt sha256 byte-match tables; exp018-022 sealed results mirrored to micrograd-quilt as receipt PRs.

lessons.lesson: Sealed receipts are immutable: provenance notes amend (audit note naming the lab's canonical home) without rewriting history — the citation pin lives in tests.
A seal naming its producer by workspace path ('workspace/labs/qcells') is a doctrinal citation, not currency: it identifies the work, not the repo — name the repo.

micrograd-quilt.purpose: The qcells local lab (labs/qcells): novel experimentation on the MicroMoth substrate; exp018-036 lineage with per-exp sealed results booked back into MicroMoth-quilt.

lessons.lesson: Lab findings earn currency when a merged PR in the ledger repo consumes them: micrograd-quilt#7 earned ledger-to-lab mass, mirrored six hours later by MicroMoth-quilt#29 — the mesh's first VERIFIED-in-both-directions pair.

quilt-ewitness.purpose: E-process witness substrate (src/eproc.mjs): anytime-valid e-processes for 'it learned' training claims — Ville bound 1/delta, sigma pre-registered under refusal, retraction built in.

lessons.lesson: Anytime-valid e-process witnesses: Ville bound 1/delta with sigma pre-registered under refusal and retraction built in — training claims can be witnessed, not asserted.

delta-shape.purpose: E-sign drift-significance layer: witnessDrift() consumes the vendored quilt-ewitness instrument, sha256-checking its bytes before trusting them (pinned BY BYTES @61b9e04).

lessons.lesson: The hash IS the identity: witnessDrift() refuses to witness vendored bytes whose sha256 does not match the pinned digest — mismatched instruments refuse to witness.
Delta-shape is the sixth to-node born after seeding and entered the view at full VERIFIED mass — new repos can enter the mesh immediately when a merge lands the citation.

backward-holdem.purpose: Backward-holdem tick-WAL substrate (born 2026-10-02): strict type-safe tick schema; the parser rejects unknown kinds and wrong arities.

lessons.lesson: Strict type-safe tick WAL: the parser rejects unknown event kinds outright rather than coercing.

quilt-overhead.purpose: Overhead-board feed.v1 dialect (born 2026-10-02): {cells:[{id,name,agent,x,y in [0,1],doc,deltas:[{t,kind,size}]}]} with quilt-overhead#1 as first receipt.

lessons.lesson: feed.v1: a minimal cell+deltas dialect for overhead boards, born with its first merged receipt.

git-agent.purpose: First quilt-native fleet agent: quilt_emit.py maps vessel lifecycle events one-to-one to BIND/LINK/EFFECT/VIEW/TICK lines in an fnv1a hash-chained JSONL WAL; GRAND-QUILT.md carries the provenance block.

lessons.lesson: An agent citation that names the doctrine but not the source repo stays PENDING ('doctrinal only'); currency arrived when git-agent#4 named AI-Writings/algebra.md by name and URL in-repo.
quilt_emit.py: vessel events map one-to-one onto the five-opcode spine — the fleet WAL is language-agnostic JSONL.

AI-Writings.purpose: The fleet's writing canon (3.5GB): algebra.md 'The Five Opcodes' (BIND/LINK/EFFECT/VIEW/TICK, +FORGET) is the canonical fleet WAL spine; labs/jev-kat/jev_kat.mjs is the canonical JEV known-answer instrument.

lessons.lesson: algebra.md defines the five-opcode spine and its laws (BIND idempotent; do not add opcodes) — the fleet WAL canon everything else cites.
Canon instruments are pinned by bytes: AI-Writings#70 shipped the canonical KAT instrument, consumed by jev-quilt at pinned commit 3f840588 + sha256.
